notes: Conducted 20 targeted WebSearch queries (budget limit reached) covering Serge missionaries, staff, and donation pages. Identified 8 Tier A field missionaries with personal designation pages on give.serge.org, 6 Tier B HQ/support staff, and partial data on Marc Davis. Rose Marie Miller (deceased) excluded per protocol. Organization has 325+ missionaries in 29 countries; focus was on named individuals with direct evidence via serge.org or give.serge.org pages.

people.summary: Serge — Physician missionaries, East Africa Area Directors
people.fit_reason: Tier A: Support-raised missionaries with give.serge.org personal donation page. Both physicians serving in Uganda since 1993 (except 8 years Kenya). Leadership roles managing East Africa region (Uganda, Kenya, Burundi, DRC, Malawi, South Sudan).

people.summary: Serge — Medical missionaries serving in Burundi
people.fit_reason: Tier A: Support-raised medical missionary couple with give.serge.org personal donation page. Serving at Kibuye Hope Hospital in one of world's poorest nations. Three children (Toby, Amos, Timothy). Completed post-residency training.

people.summary: Serge — Ophthalmologist and missionary family serving in Africa
people.fit_reason: Tier A: Support-raised medical missionary family with give.serge.org personal donation page. Served 15 years in East/Central Africa; ophthalmology specialist. Developed Hope Africa University teaching hospital in Kibuye, Burundi (2011-2021).

people.summary: Serge — Missionaries with church planting ministry since 2015
people.fit_reason: Tier A: Support-raised missionaries with give.serge.org personal donation page. Serving since 2015 in Thailand. Church planting, training Thai church leaders and missionary families. Ben has chaplain/aviation background; Becca has social work background.

people.summary: Serge — Missionary couple, formerly Uganda, now UK (justice/mercy ministry)
people.fit_reason: Tier A: Support-raised missionaries with give.serge.org personal designation page. Served Uganda 2015-2018 (refugee ministry); now in UK for justice/mercy deed ministry to unreached community in Southall. Originally from Orlando; have children.

people.summary: Serge — Media specialist, visual storyteller, photographer/videographer
people.fit_reason: Tier A: Field missionary with media role at Serge East Africa. Serves with wife Jenna and four children. Documentary photographer, video producer, drone pilot. Advocates for Serge programs across East Africa via visual content. Based in Kampala/Fort Portal.

people.summary: Serge — Photographer/filmmaker, Director of Friends of Kapsowar nonprofit
people.fit_reason: Tier A: Field missionary with husband Dr. Strutner and three children at Kapsowar Mission Hospital. Photographer/filmmaker supporting social work dept. Directs Friends of Kapsowar nonprofit supporting hospital. Husband joined 2023 with Serge.

people.summary: Serge — Missionaries in Central Europe since 2018
people.fit_reason: Tier A: Support-raised missionaries with give.serge.org personal donation page. Serving in Brno, Czech Republic since 2018. History of short-term missions in region since 1998; full-year residency 2001. Two adult children.

people.summary: Serge — Discipleship Mentor, Renewal team, podcast host
people.fit_reason: Tier B: HQ/support staff with Serge. Based in Philadelphia. Discipleship Mentor with Renewal team supporting missionaries in the field. Hosts Grace at the Fray podcast interviewing missionaries and ministry leaders. Has wife Lori and 3 children (Lucia, Ephram, Talitha). Also maintains independent pastoral ministry.
Tier B: HQ leadership. Newly appointed executive director of Serge. First name only provided in search results; full name requires direct contact with leadership page.

people.summary: Serge — Former Executive Director (23 years with org, 20 as director)
people.fit_reason: Tier B: HQ leadership/advisory. Former executive director with 23 years Serge tenure. Currently working 2-year transition maintaining donor relationships and advising leadership team. Donor relationship and advisory roles.

Tier B: HQ administrative staff. People Development Senior Manager leading event management for missionary assessment/orientation process. Project and strategic support to People Development and Intercultural Development teams.
Tier B: HQ administrative staff. HR Director hired September 2024. Recent addition to leadership team managing human resources function.
Tier B: HQ technical staff. IT leadership role managing databases, data applications, and technical operations. Studied computer science at Covenant College.
Needs review: Found on give.serge.org donation page but search budget exhausted before gathering detailed information on role, location, or field assignment.
